answer: Reaching the signal of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The vertex holds work receipts rather than names, so the comet of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, capped per identity per epoch, no identity may audit its own recruit.
